issue.title: Remove deprecated f6 untracked/tracked JSON keys after the first release containing bob-cli-fl
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Remove the deprecated f6 JSON keys that bob-cli-fl (Off-Clock Pomodoros) kept emitting beside their `off_clock` replacements, once the first bob-cli release that contains bob-cli-fl has shipped. bob-cli-fl first landed in commit 8a9ec685; the latest tag at filing time is v0.4.0 (2026-10-27), which predates it.

Per plan:202611/off_clock_pomodoros.md ("Deprecated f6 keys stay one release"), each f6 key keeps being emitted next to its `off_clock` replacement until that release ships:
- `bob capture-pomodoros --tasks`: `pomodoros[].tracked: false`, `completed_summary.untracked_count`, `events.rows[].untracked`, `items[].event.untracked`
- `bob capture`: `pomodoro_start.untracked`, `pomodoro_start.event_run.untracked` (and its events), `event_conflict.event.untracked`, `pomodoro_blocks[].tracked`/`untracked`
- `bob gcal list` / `bob gcal sync` JSON: `untracked`
- Pomodoro homes objects: `untracked: true`
- `bob stats`: health `untracked_sessions`, and the `sessions[]` compat untracked markers

Work:
1. Confirm with `git tag --contains 8a9ec685` that a released tag contains the epic.
2. Drop each key from the emitters, the goldens (`tests/fixtures/capture_pomodoros/agenda-*.json`, the stats and homes fixtures), and `docs/reference/json-outputs.md`, `docs/capture.md`, `docs/gcal.md`, `docs/stats.md`, `docs/pomodoro-homes.md`.
3. Mark the commit `!`, because removing a JSON key is a contract break (decisions:bob-cli-releases-ride-a-daily-train).

The clients already read `off_clock` first: bob-plugins (bob-ledger-tools, task-status-cycler) and bob-mac-capture (`decodeIfPresent` fallbacks). Their fallbacks can stay, or can be removed in the same change. Search both repos for `untracked` before removing anything.

The plan named this the epic's own follow-up ("The last phase to land records a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP to remove the deprecated f6 keys after the first release that contains this epic"). It cannot happen inside bob-cli-fl because it must wait for a release that contains the epic. No phase recorded it, so the land agent files it here.

task_type_fields.proposal: Stop emitting the deprecated f6 keys (tracked, untracked, untracked_count, untracked_sessions, homes untracked) beside their off_clock replacements once a bob-cli release containing bob-cli-fl (8a9ec685) has shipped; update goldens and docs; mark the commit !.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-fl deliberately keeps these keys for one release so clients can upgrade in either order; removal must wait for a release tag that contains the epic, which does not exist yet (latest v0.4.0 predates it).

issue.creation_reason: Plan off_clock_pomodoros.md requires a follow-up to retire the f6 JSON keys one release after the epic ships; no phase recorded it, so the bob-cli-fl land agent files it.
